artistBio: Uxban is a young rapper and producer from Hamilton, New Zealand, born in 2010. He is recognized for his work in the underground rap genre, blending heavy, atmospheric production with personal, emotional, and aggressive lyrics.

descriptions.ux: This track is a collaboration between Uxban and $HXDOW that blends emotional themes with underground trap influences. Centered around betrayal, distance, and changing relationships, the song contrasts melodic hooks from $HXDOW with Uxban’s more aggressive and flex-heavy verses. References to luxury fashion, isolation, and personal growth run throughout the track, while the repeated chorus reflects the frustration of wanting honesty from somebody who has already changed.
descriptions.on-you: “On You” is a song by Uxban, a rapper and producer from Hamilton, New Zealand. The track centers on betrayal and emotional dependency, with Uxban confronting someone who has tried to replicate his past struggles. The chorus repeats the title line, “And now the light is on you,” while the bridge reveals vulnerability: “Got me falling down on my knees / Heart cold, I can’t breathe.” The song also includes the line “Yeah, everybody using AI like anthropic drugs,” a critique of artificiality. It continues Uxban’s blend of atmospheric production with raw, personal writing.
descriptions.back2me: back2Me” is a song by Uxban, a rapper and producer from Hamilton, New Zealand. The track opens with the question, “Where is you going, my love?” and spends the rest of its runtime trying to answer it. Uxban is torn between letting go and hoping the person returns, repeating “Are you coming back to me?” throughout. The outro loops the title until it feels less like a question and more like an unresolved ache. It’s a raw, personal track about the push-and-pull of a breakup.
descriptions.uno:
“UNO” is a song from Uxban, where rap and rage come together in a catchy tune. The UNO card game becomes a metaphor for love, trust and consequences when everything falls apart. The energetic and chant-like hooks contrast with the lyrics and narrative, painting love as an emotional game.

Betrayal is depicted as playing the hand wrong, with the power of reversing cards equal to double-crossing your partner.
descriptions.switch-up: “SWITCH UP” by Uxban, produced by Andrew (Prod. Andrew), explores feelings of isolation, frustration, and emotional burnout while balancing relationships, and the pressure of pursuing music. The song mixes vulnerable lyrics with aggressive delivery, reflecting the emotional conflict throughout the track.
descriptions.dying-inna-red: “Dying Inna Red” is a collaboration between Uxban and Wylie J! that leans into an aggressive underground trap sound built around repetition, ad-libs, and high-energy delivery. The track contrasts braggadocious flexes, luxury references, and street-influenced imagery with a darker, obsessive hook centered on risk, pressure, and paranoia. Throughout the song, both artists alternate between melodic repetition and fast-paced verses, creating a chaotic but consistent tone that matches the intensity of the beat.
